simple.meaning: צוֹאָה (tsôwʼâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “excrement ; generally, dirt ; figuratively, pollution.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צוֹאָה (H6675) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Kings 18:27, with occurrences in 2 Kings, Proverbs, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צוֹאָה (H6675) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צוֹאָה (H6675) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צוֹאָה (tsôwʼâh) / H6675 is traced through 2 Kings 18:27, Proverbs 30:12, Isaiah 4:4, Isaiah 28:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

timeline.evidenceText: But Rabshakeh said to them, “Has my master sent me to your master and to you, to speak these words? Hasn’t he sent me to the men who sit on the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own urine with you?”
There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes,
when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it, by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning.
For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.

But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”

definitions.full: H6675. tsoah or tsoah(844b) צֹאָה noun feminine filth ; — absolute ׳צ Isa 28:8 (of drunkards' vomit, compare קִיא ); ׳צ figurative of iniquity, construct צֹאַת 4:4 , suffix צֹאָתוֺ Prov 30:12 ; specifically of human excrement ( = [ צֵאָה ]) suffix צֵאָתָם 2Kin 18:27 = Isa 36:12 . (both Qr; Kt חר(א)יהם , compare [ חֶרֶא ] p. 351 above).
